summary: Backend-only validation of (A) Custom-Job service visibility (all vs requester_only) and (B) additional-work tax recompute. All 19 pytest tests PASS against the live preview backend. Visibility rules enforced correctly for guest / other-customer / requester across both list and detail endpoints; invalid visibility value returns 400; non-admin convert/visibility return 403. _recompute_additional math matches spec exactly (parts no GST/commission, GST only on labour commission).
critical_code_review_comments: custom_job_routes.py PATCH /visibility accepts a plain dict instead of a Pydantic model — type-safety is only in the service layer.
booking_controller.py is >4200 lines; recommend splitting (adds/billing/chat/reschedule) for maintainability.
_recompute_additional correctly uses booking.commission_config snapshot before settings (platform_pct ladder); GST only on commission portion matches spec.
test_credentials: Admin +919000000000, Requester +919000000777, Other +919000000888. OTP is dynamic — captured from `dev_otp` field in /api/auth/send-otp response (demo mode). Fixed OTP '123456' does NOT work.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 TEST custom-job request → converted to draft service → activated with base_price=999. Visibility toggled to 'all' at end of run. Service remains in DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use dev_otp from send-otp response (not fixed '123456'). conftest.py in /app/backend/tests requires REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env var. Project pytest.ini enables xdist loadscope — run with `-o addopts=` to disable parallel distribution for order-dependent fixture flows.
